caption: Stadhuis, Dokkum
composition: 1835 cornice facade, Justitia on the pediment, open bell cupola · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Dokkum town hall presents the 1835 cornice facade, a central risalit and an empire pediment with the Justitia figure, and an open bell cupola on the roof. The older scroll gable is gone. The interior is closed. The sky is overcast, about 10.6°C, with wind near 6.1 km/h and cloud cover about 95%. The canal De Zijl lies in the foreground.
